Title: Murder
Description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.
Keywords: murder, kill, death, homicide, killed, murdered, fatal, deadly assault

Title: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
Description: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.
Keywords: culpable homicide, unintentional death, negligent death, rash act causing death

Title: Attempt to Murder
Description: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge and in such circumstances that if he caused death he would be guilty of murder.
Keywords: attempt to murder, attempted murder, tried to kill, attack, assault with intent

Title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
Description: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt shall be punished with imprisonment up to one year or fine up to Rs 1000 or both.
Keywords: hurt, injury, assault, beat, beaten, physical assault, violent, attacked

Title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt by Dangerous Weapons
Description: Causing hurt by means of dangerous weapons or means.
Keywords: weapon, knife, gun, dangerous weapon, armed assault, blade, firearm

Title: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt
Description: Causing grievous hurt punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
Keywords: grievous hurt, serious injury, severe injury, fracture, permanent damage

Title: Assault or Criminal Force to Woman with Intent to Outrage Her Modesty
Description: Assault or use of criminal force on woman with intent to outrage her modesty.
Keywords: molestation, outrage modesty, assault woman, inappropriate touch, sexual harassment

Title: Rape
Description: Punishment for rape - imprisonment of either description for a term of not less than 10 years.
Keywords: rape, sexual assault, forced intercourse, sexual violence, molest

Title: Unnatural Offences
Description: Whoever voluntarily has carnal intercourse against the order of nature.
Keywords: unnatural offence, sodomy, carnal intercourse

Title: Theft
Description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both.
Keywords: theft, steal, stolen, robbery, burglary, took, missing, pickpocket

Title: Theft in Dwelling House
Description: Theft in dwelling house or means of transportation or place of worship.
Keywords: house theft, home burglary, house breaking, residential theft

Title: Robbery
Description: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.
Keywords: robbery, robbed, armed robbery, dacoity, loot, snatched

Title: Dacoity
Description: Whoever commits dacoity shall be punished with imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.
Keywords: dacoity, gang robbery, armed gang, multiple robbers

Title: Criminal Breach of Trust
Description: Punishment for criminal breach of trust.
Keywords: breach of trust, embezzlement, misappropriation, fraud, cheating

Title: Cheating and Dishonestly Inducing Delivery of Property
Description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property.
Keywords: cheating, fraud, deceive, dishonest, scam, duped, conned, fake

Title: Forgery
Description: Whoever commits forgery shall be punished with imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both.
Keywords: forgery, fake document, forged, counterfeit, false document

Title: Forgery of Valuable Security
Description: Forgery of valuable security, will, or authority to make or transfer any valuable security.
Keywords: forged cheque, fake will, forged security, counterfeit certificate

Title: Cruelty by Husband or Relatives
Description: Husband or relative subjecting woman to cruelty.
Keywords: dowry, domestic violence, cruelty, harassment, torture, marital abuse

Title: Intentional Insult with Intent to Provoke Breach of Peace
Description: Whoever intentionally insults and thereby gives provocation.
Keywords: insult, provocation, abuse, verbal abuse

Title: Criminal Intimidation
Description: Whoever commits criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both.
Keywords: threat, intimidation, threatening, blackmail, coercion

Title: Word, Gesture or Act Intended to Insult the Modesty of a Woman
Description: Insult modesty of woman by word, gesture or act.
Keywords: insult woman, eve teasing, obscene gesture, verbal harassment

Title: Attempting to Commit Offences
Description: Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment.
Keywords: attempt, tried to commit, attempted
